theme: Week after Thanksgiving: pressure to look happy, shopping-week stress, FSA deadlines, seasonal depression, Giving Tuesday
notes:
GUARDRAILS
- Say may help, never cures, never outcome percentages, never testimonials.
- No Black Friday, Cyber Monday, or "sale" language on treatment. No "free consult," "free screening," or discount promos (Florida §456.062).
- The PHQ-9 and GAD-7 are described as short questionnaires used in clinics, not as a free offer.
- Include 988 on any post that touches crisis, grief, suicidality, or trauma. In Spanish: llame al 988 y oprima 2, o envíe AYUDA al 988. Veterans can press 1 after 988.
- Spanish is written in usted, in natural Mexican Spanish — not a translation of the English posts.
- HeyGen notes cover clothing, setting, and graphics only.

PRODUCTION NOTES
- Batching: Posts 1, 3, 5, 6, 8, 10, 11, and 12 can be recorded in one English HeyGen session (swap outfit and background as listed). Posts 2, 7, and 9 can be a second, Spanish session. Post 4 is a four-slide carousel only. Carousels A–D can be designed in one Instagram file (same cream/navy system); E and F can be designed as a matching pair of LinkedIn PDFs. If Wednesday's Spravato video would duplicate carousel F on LinkedIn, keep the video on Instagram and Facebook and let the PDF carry LinkedIn that day.
- Audio: No trending holiday-party audio under clinical scripts. A low, warm instrumental bed is fine; keep Jacob's voice dry and forward.
- Hashtags: The sets above are enough. Do not add #BlackFridayDeals, #CyberMondaySale, or any discount language.
- If a post has to slip: Keep Thursday's two videos, Friday's "no sale" video, Monday's FSA video, and Wednesday's Spravato video. Those five carry the week. For carousels, keep A, B, E, and F if you have to cut.
- Not used this week, still useful later: repressed memories; religious scrupulosity / OCD; "does ketamine lower blood pressure?"; ketamine vs. antidepressants; postpartum depression (better as a stand-alone week, not a holiday add-on); insurer-by-insurer Spravato guides.

*Drafted Nov 25, 2026, for the week of Nov 26–Dec 2. Captions and scripts are ready to paste; adjust only if clinic hours, network status, or Kelsey's review notes change.*

CAROUSEL DESIGN
Instagram: 1080×1350 (4:5), typographic, one idea per slide, generous margins. Palette: warm cream background (#F7F1E8), deep navy headlines (#1B2A4A), clay accent (#C46B4A), soft sage for secondary labels (#7A8F7A). Headlines in a refined serif (Playfair Display or Source Serif 4); body in a clean sans (Source Sans 3 or Nunito Sans). No patient photos, no treatment-room clinical shots, no stock "grateful family dinner." A single quiet still (a lamp, an empty chair, a window) is enough on the cover if you want imagery; otherwise keep it type-only.

LinkedIn: post as a PDF document, 1080×1080 (1:1); 4:5 is fine if you post native images instead. Document style: white ground, a thin navy header bar, slide numbers (01 / 09) in the top right, a one-line footer on every slide — "Rewired Ketamine · Aventura, FL · Educational, not medical advice." Headlines and body in the same professional sans (Inter or Helvetica). Sparse line icons, no lifestyle photography. Keep a consistent left margin so the PDF feels like one briefing.

Same guardrails as the rest of the plan: may help, never cures; no outcome statistics; no testimonials; no discount or "free" promos; 988 on any carousel that touches crisis, grief, trauma, or suicidal ideation. Lines below are original, not attributed quotes.

posts.topic: You don't have to perform gratitude
posts.hook: Loneliness in a full room, and the pressure to look happier than you feel — not family-dinner drama.
posts.caption:
If today feels heavier than the table looks, you are not the only one.

A lot of people feel lonely even in a full room. A lot of people feel pressure to look happier than they really are. That is not a gratitude problem. It is a human one.

You do not have to perform today. A short walk, one honest text, or sitting a part of the day out is enough.

If the low mood or the worry has been hanging on for weeks — not just today — it may help to put some words to it before you talk with a professional. The GAD-7 is a short anxiety questionnaire used in clinics everywhere. It is not a diagnosis.

https://www.rewiredketamine.com/tools/gad-7-anxiety-test

If you are in crisis, call or text 988, 24 hours a day. In an emergency, call 911.

— Dr. Jacob Silverstone, Rewired Ketamine, Aventura

#Thanksgiving #MentalHealth #HolidayStress #Anxiety #Aventura #Miami #SouthFlorida #RewiredKetamine

posts.hook: The phrases many Latino families use with love — "échale ganas," "los trapos sucios se lavan en casa" — and permission not to pretend. This is about stigma, not a fight at the table.
posts.caption:
Hoy muchas casas se llenan, y aun así hay quien se siente solo en esa misma mesa.

En muchas familias latinas crecimos oyendo "échale ganas," "los trapos sucios se lavan en casa," "eso se arregla en familia." Casi siempre se dicen con cariño. Y aun así, pedirle ayuda a un profesional puede sentirse como un fracaso.

La depresión y la ansiedad no se quitan con pura fuerza de voluntad. Pedir ayuda no es debilidad: es cuidar de usted y de los suyos.

Escribí una guía, en español, sobre cómo hablar de esto en casa — y cómo pedir ayuda sin vergüenza.

https://www.rewiredketamine.com/es/content/blog/salud-mental-en-familias-latinas

Si usted está en crisis, llame al 988 y oprima 2 para español, o envíe AYUDA por mensaje de texto al 988, las 24 horas. Si está en peligro inmediato, llame al 911.

— Dr. Jacob Silverstone, Rewired Ketamine, Aventura

posts.topic: No sale on your mental health
posts.hook: Countdown-timer anxiety and gift-budget stress, without a clinic deal. Published prices exist so people can think clearly, not so they impulse-buy care.
posts.caption:
This is not a Black Friday post.

The "limited time" language this weekend is designed to rush you. For a lot of people, that pile-on — gifts, travel, the feeling you might miss something — is what actually spikes the anxiety.

We are not putting treatment on sale. Medical care is not a doorbuster. If you are looking at ketamine or Spravato, take the time to understand the numbers first. Our IV prices are published, and there is a cost calculator on our site that walks through packages in plain language. No countdown timer.

https://www.rewiredketamine.com/tools/ketamine-cost-calculator

If the worry itself has been hard to shut off, the GAD-7 questionnaire can help you describe it before you talk with a clinician: https://www.rewiredketamine.com/tools/gad-7-anxiety-test

— Dr. Jacob Silverstone, Rewired Ketamine, Aventura

#BlackFriday #HolidayStress #FinancialAnxiety #MentalHealth #Aventura #Miami #KetamineTherapy #RewiredKetamine

posts.hook: A saveable two-column chart. Holiday blues usually ease when the week calms down. Seasonal depression is more persistent and starts to get in the way of daily life. Ketamine is not framed as a SAD treatment.
posts.caption:
A low mood after a long holiday week is common. That is not automatically seasonal depression.

Holiday blues are usually tied to the week itself — the disruption, the travel, the letdown once it is over. They tend to ease when your routine comes back.

Seasonal depression is different. It tends to return around the same time of year, last longer, and get in the way of sleep, energy, or daily life. If that is what you are noticing, it is worth talking with a clinician. Light, routine, and established treatments are the usual starting point.

If you want a structured way to describe your symptoms before that conversation, the PHQ-9 is a nine-question depression questionnaire used in clinics worldwide. It is not a diagnosis.

https://www.rewiredketamine.com/tools/phq-9-depression-test

If you are in crisis, call or text 988. In an emergency, call 911.

— Dr. Jacob Silverstone, Rewired Ketamine, Aventura

#SeasonalDepression #HolidayBlues #MentalHealth #PHQ9 #Aventura #Miami #RewiredKetamine

heygen.script:
If your mood dropped this weekend, that does not automatically mean you have seasonal depression.

Holiday blues are usually tied to the week itself — less sleep, a broken routine, the letdown after a big day. They often ease when life gets quieter. Seasonal depression is more than that. It tends to come back around the same time of year, last for weeks, and start to interfere with sleep, energy, or getting through the day.

If that sounds familiar, talk with a clinician. You do not have to figure out the label on your own. There is a nine-question questionnaire on our site, the PHQ-9, that many clinics use to help people describe symptoms. It is not a diagnosis, and it is not a substitute for care.

If you are in crisis, call or text 988. I am Dr. Jacob Silverstone, at Rewired Ketamine in Aventura.

posts.topic: FSA use-it-or-lose-it, not a Cyber Monday deal
posts.hook: Cyber Monday is a useful reminder only because many FSA plan years end December 31. This is money already set aside, not a coupon. HSAs roll over; FSAs often do not, unless the employer offers a grace period or a limited carryover. The date that usually counts is the date of service, not the date you pay. Confirmation is up to the plan administrator; this is not tax advice.
posts.caption:
This is not a Cyber Monday deal.

If you have a health FSA, check your plan-year date. For many people that date is December 31. Unused FSA money may be forfeited unless your employer offers a grace period or a limited carryover. HSAs are different: that balance is yours and it rolls over.

Ketamine treatment that a licensed clinician prescribes and provides for a medical condition can generally be a qualified medical expense, including IV sessions, your share of Spravato visits, and prescribed at-home ketamine. Your plan administrator decides what it will approve. We cannot guarantee that any expense will be accepted, and this is not tax advice.

Two questions to ask your administrator this week: When does my plan year end? Do I have a grace period or a carryover? And remember: the date that usually counts is the date you received the care, not the date you paid.

We provide an itemized receipt or superbill, and a letter of medical necessity if your plan asks for one.

https://www.rewiredketamine.com/services/hsa-fsa-ketamine

To see what a course may cost first: https://www.rewiredketamine.com/tools/ketamine-cost-calculator

— Dr. Jacob Silverstone, Rewired Ketamine, Aventura

#CyberMonday #FSA #HSA #UseItOrLoseIt #MentalHealth #Aventura #Miami #RewiredKetamine

heygen.script:
This is not a Cyber Monday sale. I am bringing it up because a lot of health FSAs run on a calendar year, and unused money may be gone after December 31 unless your plan has a grace period or a carryover.

An HSA is different. That money stays yours and rolls over. An FSA is set up through your employer, and the rules are stricter.

In general, ketamine treatment prescribed and provided by a licensed clinician for a medical condition can be a qualified medical expense. That may include IV sessions, your share of Spravato visits, and prescribed at-home ketamine. Your plan administrator has the final say, so check with them before you pay. We cannot promise that any expense will be accepted.

Ask two things this week: when does my plan year end, and do I have a grace period or a carryover? The date that usually counts is the date you received the care, not the date you paid. I am Dr. Jacob Silverstone, at Rewired Ketamine in Aventura. There is a plain-language guide on our site.

Esto no es una oferta de Cyber Monday.

Si usted tiene una cuenta FSA de salud, revise cuándo termina su año de plan. En muchos casos es el 31 de diciembre. El dinero que no se use se puede perder, a menos que su empleador ofrezca un período de gracia o un traspaso limitado. La HSA es distinta: ese saldo es suyo y pasa al año siguiente.

En general, el tratamiento con ketamina que un clínico con licencia receta y proporciona para una condición médica puede ser un gasto médico calificado. Quien decide si lo aprueba es el administrador de su plan. Nosotros no podemos garantizar que un gasto sea aceptado, y esto no es asesoría fiscal.

Dos preguntas para hacer esta semana: ¿cuándo termina mi año de plan? ¿Tengo período de gracia o traspaso? Y un detalle que se suele pasar por alto: lo que cuenta, por lo general, es la fecha en que recibió la atención, no la fecha en que pagó.

posts.topic: Giving Tuesday — showing up for someone
posts.hook: Giving Tuesday without a donation ask and without a treatment promo. The useful gift is often staying nearby and not trying to fix someone. Ties to the new caregivers' guide for at-home ketamine in Florida.
posts.caption:
Giving Tuesday does not have to be about a purchase.

If someone you love is going through depression, anxiety, trauma, or a new treatment, the most useful thing you can give is often quieter than a gift bag. Stay nearby. Follow their lead. You do not have to watch every minute, and you do not have to have a speech ready.

We wrote a practical guide for caregivers supporting someone through at-home ketamine treatment in Florida — what to do before a dose, what to keep calm during one, when to call us, when to call 911, and how to look after yourself too.

https://www.rewiredketamine.com/content/blog/caregivers-guide-at-home-ketamine-florida

If they talk about harming themselves, call or text 988, or call 911.

— Dr. Jacob Silverstone, Rewired Ketamine, Aventura

#GivingTuesday #Caregivers #MentalHealth #AtHomeKetamine #Aventura #Miami #RewiredKetamine

heygen.script:
On Giving Tuesday I do not want to ask you to buy anything. I want to talk about the people who show up for someone else.

If someone you love is going through a hard stretch — depression, anxiety, trauma, or a new treatment — you do not need a perfect speech. Stay in the home. Check in from time to time. Keep the room quiet. Follow their lead if they want to talk, or if they do not.

We wrote a short caregiver's guide for families supporting someone through at-home ketamine treatment here in Florida. It covers what to do before a dose, what to watch for, when to call our clinic, and when to call 911. It also says something I want you to hear: this is hard work, and you can ask for help too.

posts.topic: Spravato can now be used on its own for TRD
posts.hook: A still-common myth. In January 2025 the FDA approved Spravato as monotherapy for treatment-resistant depression in adults. An oral antidepressant is no longer required for that use. It is still required, together with Spravato, for depressive symptoms in major depression with acute suicidal ideation or behavior. Do not change a medicine without a clinician. Approval and coverage are not guaranteed.
posts.caption:
If you still think Spravato has to be taken with a daily antidepressant, that information is out of date.

In January 2025, the FDA approved Spravato (esketamine) as monotherapy for treatment-resistant depression in adults. For that use, an oral antidepressant is no longer required. It can still be used together with one, and that decision belongs with your clinician — do not stop a medicine on your own.

One important exception: for depressive symptoms in major depression with acute suicidal ideation or behavior, Spravato is still approved together with an oral antidepressant. Spravato is not a substitute for emergency care, and it has not been shown to prevent suicide.

Visits still happen in a REMS-certified clinic, with at least two hours of monitoring. You will need a ride home. Insurance usually requires prior authorization. We currently bill Spravato in-network with UnitedHealthcare, Cigna, and Aetna; Florida Blue is out of network at our clinic. Approval is never guaranteed.

https://www.rewiredketamine.com/services/spravato

If you are in crisis, call or text 988, or call 911.

— Dr. Jacob Silverstone, Rewired Ketamine, Aventura

One exception matters: when Spravato is used for depression with acute suicidal thoughts or behavior, it is still approved together with an oral antidepressant. It is not a substitute for emergency care.

posts.topic: After the holiday shifts: first responders and veterans
posts.hook: Firefighters, police, EMS, dispatchers, and veterans often work the holiday, then sit with the quiet afterward. Confidentiality, off-label use for PTSD, and 988 / Veterans Crisis Line. Ketamine may help some people as part of a broader plan; it is not a cure and not FDA-approved for PTSD.
posts.caption:
If you worked Thanksgiving or the weekend so other people could sit down, the quiet afterward can be its own kind of hard.

We see firefighters, police officers, EMS crews, dispatchers, and veterans in our Aventura clinic who have already tried therapy, medication, or both, and are still dealing with sleep, anger, numbness, or memories that will not settle.

Ketamine is one option some people explore for PTSD. It is not FDA-approved for PTSD, so that use is off-label. It is not a cure, and it is not right for everyone. When it is used, it belongs alongside trauma-focused therapy, not in place of it.

Your care here is private. We do not contact your department or your command.

https://www.rewiredketamine.com/content/blog/ketamine-ptsd-first-responders-veterans-florida

If you are in crisis, call or text 988. Veterans can press 1 after dialing 988 to reach the Veterans Crisis Line. In an emergency, call 911.

— Dr. Jacob Silverstone, Rewired Ketamine, Aventura

slides.headline: Permission slips for today.
slides.body: You do not have to perform gratitude.

slides.headline: You can step outside and still be a good person.
slides.body: A full table does not require a full performance. Leaving the room for air is allowed.

slides.headline: Lonely in a full room is still lonely.
slides.body: That feeling is not ingratitude. It is a human one. You can love people and still need a little quiet.

slides.headline: Small honest things count.
slides.body: A short walk. One text you actually mean. Sitting a part of the day out. You do not have to earn rest with a perfect mood.

slides.headline: If this heaviness has been here for weeks, not just today.
slides.body: Holiday blues often ease when the week calms down. If the low mood or the worry has been hanging on, it may help to put some words to it before you talk with a professional.

slides.headline: A short questionnaire can start the conversation.
slides.body: The GAD-7 is seven questions clinics use to describe anxiety. It is not a diagnosis, and it is not a substitute for care. It may help you walk into that appointment with clearer language.

slides.headline: Frases de casa, dichas de otra manera.
slides.body: Hay palabras que oímos con cariño. Y hay otra forma de acompañar.

slides.headline: En lugar de "échale ganas."
slides.body: "Estoy aquí con usted." La fuerza de voluntad no es un tratamiento. La compañía sí puede ayudar a dar el primer paso.

slides.headline: En lugar de "los trapos sucios se lavan en casa."
slides.body: Pedir ayuda también es cuidar la casa. Hablar con un profesional no es sacar los asuntos a la calle. Es atender una condición de salud.

slides.headline: En lugar de "eso se arregla en familia."
slides.body: La familia puede ser un gran apoyo. Acompañarlo a una cita, cuidar a los niños esa tarde, o simplemente no juzgar, ya es una forma de arreglar.

slides.headline: Pedir ayuda no es debilidad.
slides.body: La depresión y la ansiedad son condiciones de salud, como la presión alta. Cuidarse es también cuidar de los suyos.

slides.headline: Cómo empezar la conversación.
slides.body: Escoja un momento tranquilo. Basta con algo sencillo: "Me he sentido muy cansado y triste desde hace meses, y quiero ver a un profesional."

carousels.title: Holiday blues, or something that is staying

slides.headline: Holiday blues, or something that is staying?
slides.body: A low mood after a long week is common. It is not automatically seasonal depression.

slides.headline: Holiday blues are usually tied to the week itself.
slides.body: Less sleep. A broken routine. The letdown after a big day. They often ease when ordinary life returns.

slides.headline: Seasonal depression tends to linger — and return.
slides.body: It often shows up around the same time of year, lasts for weeks, and starts to get in the way of sleep, energy, or getting through the day.

slides.headline: You do not have to name it by yourself.
slides.body: If you are not sure which one you are looking at, that is a reason to talk with a clinician, not a reason to wait for a perfect label.

slides.headline: What usually comes first.
slides.body: Light, routine, and established care — talk therapy, medication, or both — are the usual starting point. You deserve a plan that fits you, not a guess from a carousel.

slides.headline: A nine-question starting point.
slides.body: The PHQ-9 is a depression questionnaire used in clinics worldwide. It is not a diagnosis. It may help you describe symptoms before that conversation.

slides.headline: If today feels unsafe.
slides.body: Call or text 988, 24 hours a day. In an emergency, call 911. You do not have to wait until Monday.

slides.headline: Whenever you are ready.
slides.body:
Take the PHQ-9 on our site:
rewiredketamine.com/tools/phq-9-depression-test
— Rewired Ketamine, Aventura

carousels.title: The holiday stretch at work: what actually helps

slides.headline: The holiday stretch at work: what actually helps.
slides.body:
A short briefing for people who lead teams.
Footer: Rewired Ketamine · Aventura, FL

slides.headline: The pressure to look "on" does not stay at the dinner table.
slides.body: It shows up in inboxes, in stand-ups, and in the last week of November. People can be grateful and exhausted at the same time. Leaders do not have to pretend otherwise.

slides.headline: Performative cheer is not a wellness program.
slides.body: A mandatory party or a "fun" Slack thread will not land the same way for everyone. Some people are grieving. Some are stretched thin. Some worked the holiday so other people could be off.

slides.headline: What often helps more than another event.
slides.body: Predictable time off. Fewer last-minute asks. Clear coverage plans. Permission to decline the optional gathering without having to explain a personal story.

slides.headline: Financial stress is part of this season.
slides.body: Paying for gifts and travel is one of the heaviest holiday pressures. A calm, factual reminder about benefits — including FSA deadlines — is a practical kindness. It is not a sales pitch.

slides.headline: A useful FSA check-in, in plain language.
slides.body: Many health FSAs follow a calendar year. Unused money may be forfeited after December 31 unless the employer offers a grace period or a limited carryover. HSAs are different: that balance belongs to the employee and rolls over. The date that usually counts is the date care was received, not the date it was paid. This is not tax advice. Employees should confirm with the plan administrator.

slides.headline: Mental health care can generally be a qualified medical expense.
slides.body: That can include care a licensed clinician prescribes and provides for a medical condition. The plan administrator decides what it will approve. No one should be told an expense is guaranteed.

slides.headline: If someone is in crisis.
slides.body: 988 is available 24 hours a day, by call or text. Veterans can press 1 after dialing 988. This is not a substitute for emergency care. In an emergency, call 911. Managers are not clinicians; they can point people to help and to the organization's own EAP, if there is one.

slides.headline: A plain-language guide you can share.
slides.body:
When HSA and FSA funds can generally be used for ketamine treatment, what paperwork may be needed, and what to ask the plan:
rewiredketamine.com/services/hsa-fsa-ketamine
Educational, not medical or tax advice.
— Rewired Ketamine, Aventura, FL

carousels.title: What changed for Spravato in 2025

slides.headline: What changed for Spravato in 2025.
slides.body:
A short briefing for clinicians and benefits teams.
Footer: Rewired Ketamine · Aventura, FL · Educational, not medical advice

slides.headline: A still-common assumption.
slides.body: Many people still believe Spravato (esketamine) must be taken with a daily oral antidepressant. For one approved use, that information is out of date.

slides.headline: What the FDA approved in January 2025.
slides.body: Spravato was approved as monotherapy for treatment-resistant depression in adults. For that use, an oral antidepressant is no longer required.

slides.headline: It can still be used together with one.
slides.body: Using Spravato on its own, or alongside an oral antidepressant, is a decision made with the treating clinician. Patients should not stop a medicine on their own.

slides.headline: An important exception.
slides.body: For depressive symptoms in adults with major depressive disorder and acute suicidal ideation or behavior, Spravato is still approved together with an oral antidepressant.

slides.headline: What this does not mean.
slides.body: Spravato is not a substitute for emergency care or hospitalization when those are needed. It has not been shown to prevent suicide. If you or someone you are treating is in crisis, call or text 988, or call 911.

slides.headline: What did not change.
slides.body: Spravato is still given only in a REMS-certified clinic. Patients stay for at least two hours of monitoring and need a ride home. It is not taken home.

slides.headline: Insurance and authorization.
slides.body: Plans usually require prior authorization. Coverage, copays, and deductibles are set by the policy, and approval is never guaranteed. At our Aventura clinic we currently bill Spravato in-network with UnitedHealthcare, Cigna, and Aetna; Florida Blue is out of network here. Other plans can be reviewed at a consult.

slides.headline: A simple timeline to save.
slides.body:
March 2019 — TRD in adults, with an oral antidepressant.
August 2020 — Depression with acute suicidal ideation or behavior, with an oral antidepressant.
January 2025 — TRD in adults as monotherapy.
Sources are listed on our Spravato page.

carousels.caption:
If you still think Spravato has to be taken with a daily antidepressant, that information is out of date — for one approved use.

In January 2025, the FDA approved Spravato (esketamine) as monotherapy for treatment-resistant depression in adults. It can still be used with an oral antidepressant, and that decision belongs with the clinician. Patients should not stop a medicine on their own.

One exception matters: for depression with acute suicidal ideation or behavior, it is still approved together with an oral antidepressant. It is not a substitute for emergency care, and it has not been shown to prevent suicide.

This short briefing also covers what did not change (REMS, two-hour monitoring, a ride home) and how prior authorization usually works. Approval is never guaranteed.

https://www.rewiredketamine.com/services/spravato

If you are in crisis, call or text 988. In an emergency, call 911.

— Dr. Jacob Silverstone, Medical Director, Rewired Ketamine, Aventura
